sources.primary_title: Together AI and HUMAIN Form Strategic Partnership to Accelerate AI Infrastructure and Cloud Services in Saudi Arabia
sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, San Francisco-based Together AI and Saudi Arabia's HUMAIN announced a strategic partnership to construct a new 250-megawatt data center in the Kingdom. The collaboration aims to merge HUMAIN's expansive multi-chip AI infrastructure with Together AI's native cloud platform and global open-source developer ecosystem. This partnership will provide global developers and AI-native enterprises with high-performance AI infrastructure for training and inference workloads deployed in Saudi Arabia. Benefiting from the Kingdom's robust power capacity and strategic location for low-latency access to EMEA markets, the venture is projected to generate over $5 billion in gross annualized revenue during its first year. The deal strengthens Saudi Arabia's position as a global hub for next-generation AI services while supporting HUMAIN's strategy to build a complete AI value chain.
